industry: A fictional everyday walking journal: remember ordinary streets, weather and small discoveries; no pace, race or performance dashboard.
audience: Urban adults keeping personal memories of relaxed daily walks
palette: Pure white #FFFFFF exterior; terracotta belongs to application accents outside this master
styles: Upright custom lettering with intentional counter shapes and optical spacing
Flat colored master artwork; no presentation effects
use_cases: A compact product header, 240px visible wordmark width on white
A 360px mobile journal page with the same wordmark on white
forbidden: Separate stone, path, mountain, pin or leaf symbol
Extra text, labels, slogans or graphic decorations
Beige paper, textures, shadows, lighting and mockups
assumptions: Fictional brand; this is a focused recovery experiment after the user rejected the first six samples
New lettering direction; no existing typeface is being replaced
Color values are intentions, not verified raster values
